note: Stored parquet OHLC vs the API, per instrument-date. api values are authoritative. CORRECT ALL FOUR FIELDS — a close-only correction leaves the harness checking stops against an uncorrected low, which produces a false loss on a day nothing happened.

threshold_guidance.why_a_flat_1pct_is_wrong: open/close are single-print auction values and differ ~1-2% by venue/session convention (RTH vs extended). high/low are session extremes and often match to the cent. A flat 1% therefore conflates convention with corruption: of 18,162 open hits most are convention, while a wrong LOW is what gaps a stop.
threshold_guidance.recommended: filter on worst_pct. >5% is corruption; 1-2% on open/close alone is noise.
threshold_guidance.invisible_to_the_previous_manifest: 4,027 rows have a WRONG LOW and a CORRECT close. A close-only manifest could not see them, so any re-grade built on the previous file never corrected the field the stop is checked against.
